jobs.description:
**About HeyGen**
----------------

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Learn more at www.heygen.com. .

**About HeyGen**
----------------

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences. Learn more at www.heygen.com. .

**The Role**
------------

We are hiring Sales Development Representatives to build the pipeline behind HeyGen's next phase of growth. This is a full-funnel prospecting role with a heavy emphasis on outbound. You will research target accounts, run creative outbound campaigns, work product-led signals, qualify interest, and book first meetings for our Account Executives. This is not a traditional SDR role where you work someone else's list and a fixed script. We are looking for hunters who are comfortable moving fast, testing new outbound ideas, starting conversations with busy buyers, and earning meetings through persistence, creativity, and sharp research. You will prospect into companies using HeyGen's web app and API, helping buyers see how AI video can transform marketing, sales enablement, customer education, training, localization, product onboarding, and developer-powered video workflows.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Build pipeline from scratch** - You will run high-volume, high-quality outbound into target accounts. This includes cold email, phone, LinkedIn, personalized video, account research, trigger-based outreach, and creative campaign ideas. You should be excited by the idea of starting conversations that would not have happened without you.

**Mine product-led signals** - You will work with self-serve users, product usage data, sign-ups, and inbound interest to find the teams already getting value from HeyGen who are ready for a bigger conversation.

**Qualify with discipline** - You will run first conversations that uncover real pain, identify who owns the budget, and understand timing, so every meeting you book is one an Account Executive wants to take.

**Sell the outcome, not just the meeting** - You will help prospects see how HeyGen can reduce video production costs, speed up content creation, improve localization, personalize customer communication, and unlock new video workflows, so they show up to the first call already curious.

**Move fast and test** - You will try new messaging, channels, personas, and sequences, measure what works, and share it with the team. Most experiments fail; the ones that work become the playbook.

**Partner with Account Executives** - You will align with AEs on target accounts, share what you are hearing in the market, and hand off the context they need to run a strong first meeting.

**Maintain strong pipeline discipline** - You will keep CRM data clean, log activity accurately, and understand the difference between a real opportunity and a polite maybe.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 1+ years of experience in sales, business development, or another target-driven role.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding activity, meeting, or pipeline targets.
* Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting across email, phone, and LinkedIn.
* Strong discovery instincts and the ability to find a real business problem in a first conversation.
* Comfort reaching out to marketing, sales, customer success, L&D, product, operations, founder, or technical stakeholders.
* A high-agency, builder mindset. You do not wait for perfect playbooks. You test, learn, and iterate.
* Strong written communication skills. Your cold emails and follow-ups should be clear, short, and get replies.
* Curiosity about AI, video, creative workflows, and API-driven products.

**Nice-to-Haves**
-----------------

* SDR or BDR experience at a PLG, usage-based, API, creative software, marketing technology, sales technology, or AI company.
* Experience prospecting into marketing, localization, customer education, learning and development, sales enablement, ecommerce, media, or product teams.
* Experience using video, personalization, AI tools, or creative outbound to start conversations.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth startup environment.

**Who Will Thrive Here**
------------------------

* Gets energy from prospecting and hunting.
* Can write a sharp cold email without waiting for marketing to give you a template.
* Is comfortable making calls, sending videos, testing messaging, and following up persistently.
* Treats a target as a game to win, not a burden.
* Does not need a fully built sales playbook to be productive.
* Wants to become a top-performing Account Executive and is willing to earn it.
* Is competitive, resourceful, and organized.
* Knows how to balance volume with thoughtful qualification.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* Competitive base salary plus variable pay.
* Equity in a high-growth AI company.
* Health, dental, and vision benefits.
* Flexible PTO.
* A clear path into a closing Account Executive role.
* High ownership, high velocity, and direct impact on revenue growth.

Equal Opportunity HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a creative content creator who hops on a trend with the best of them and is also an analytics-forward number-nerd. This person can put together a strategy, read the data, and run a client call, then show up to a shoot with a shot list and a plan.

Sierra G, LLC is a boutique organic social media agency for founder-led brands. Strategy and creative live under one roof, and our clients include pilates and wellness studios, med spas, local retail, hospitality, and professional services.

We're hiring a Bay Area-based Account Manager to own a handful of accounts start to finish. This is more than a social media manager role. You'll own the strategy and the client relationship, you'll create the content yourself, and you'll be our team on the ground at shoots and media days. Our ideal hire is obsessed with social media content, building client relationships, and watching their social strategies lead results.

**Results first, always**

We care about our clients and their business goals, and those goals are at the forefront of every social media strategy we build. We want content creators who care about client results as much as we do.

That means understanding what a client's business actually needs, then building a plan to help them reach their goal. Here's our rhythm:

* **Build the plan.** Start with the client's business goals and map the content to them.
* **Execute.** Create and post content that serves the plan.
* **Check the reports.** See what's working and what isn't.
* **Refine.** Adjust based on what the data tells you.
* **Repeat.**

**What you'll own**

You own the account. The strategy, the client relationship, and the results are yours, and the client always feels taken care of.

* **Strategy and content pillars.** Tie every month to the client's real business goals, their pillars, and what's coming up for them (launches, promos, seasonality). No filling days with posts just to fill them.
* **Monthly content calendars.** Build each client's calendar far enough ahead to protect our runway, delivered on our 5th and 20th cycles.
* **Content creation.** Bring the calendar to life yourself. Design the graphics and carousels, film and edit short-form video, and write hooks that stop the scroll.
* **Shoots and media days.** Build the shot list, show up in person, direct the shoot, and capture content so nothing is left to guesswork.
* **Brand voice.** Keep every account on-brand and on-voice over time, and set the creative direction for our content team.
* **Client communication.** Be the client's main point of contact in Slack (weekdays, 9 to 6). Always know the posting status of your accounts, and if something needs to move, you're the one who tells the client why and what the fix is.
* **Monthly client calls.** Prep the agenda, lead the conversation, and walk the client through their report.
* **Reporting and KPIs.** Deliver the monthly analytics report and know your numbers cold. We care about saves, shares, reach, DMs, and bookings way more than follower counts. When a KPI is off, you bring a plan and start it.
* **Onboarding.** Own a new client's first 30 days: discovery, brand voice extraction, and the first calendar.
* **Retention and growth.** Read the room for churn risk early, protect our scope (hello, 2-revision limit), and flag when a client is ready for more.
* **Documentation.** Keep your accounts organized in Notion so if you're out, nothing goes dark.

**Who you are**

You can hit the ground running. We'll train you on our systems and how we do things, but you already know how to build a strategy and create great content.

**Must-haves**

* Based in the Bay Area and able to get to client shoots in person, plus a weekly in-person work day with me
* 2+ years of hands-on social media experience for brands, an agency, or your own freelance clients
* You've built a content strategy around a client's business goals and can explain why every piece of content exists
* You're a strong content creator who can build a content calendar AND execute it
* You can run a shoot start to finish on your own: plan it, direct it, and capture it
* Strong short-form video editing skills in Edits, CapCut, or similar
* You know how to grab attention in short-form video with strong hooks, pacing, on-screen text, and trending audio
* You can design on-brand graphics and carousels
* A strong visual and aesthetic eye. Making things look beautiful comes naturally, no hand-holding needed
* You're polished with clients and stay calm when someone says "we're not seeing results"
* You can read analytics and turn the numbers into a clear story and a next step
* Availability for scheduled daytime shoots and client calls

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with hospitality, wellness, med spa, or retail brands
* Familiarity with Notion, Slack, Canva, or Rella

**The vibe**

You're warm, organized, and always a step ahead. Clients trust you on set and on Zoom, and the goal is for them to ask for you by name.

**The details**

Schedule: Part-time to start, flexible around scheduled shoots and client calls

Location: Bay Area. Remote most days, plus a weekly in-person day and on-site shoots

Team: A small, global team of account managers and content creators

This is a part-time role to start. The right candidate will grow to full time as the business grows.

**Where this goes**

Your path here is Account Manager to Client-Facing Strategist, and your pay grows as you step up. You're ready for that next step when you're consistently:
